title: A long-term clinical outcome of Hoffmann pocket four-point scleral fixated intraocular lens implantation combined with penetrating keratoplasty – A single corneal surgeon’s report

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 License; no licence URL in the XML)

groups.description: Penetrating keratoplasty combined in the same operation with Hoffman-pocket four-point scleral-fixated PMMA intraocular lens implantation (IOL fixation; IOL explantation, iridodialysis repair, iridoplasty, pupilloplasty or anterior vitrectomy as needed); 42 eyes of 42 patients aged 11-84 years, all patients who underwent the procedure by one corneal surgeon, 2008-2020. Lens status before surgery: 23 aphakic, 15 pseudophakic, 4 phakic (the handling of the crystalline lens in the phakic eyes is not described). Indications mixed (trauma, congenital pathology, post-infection, aphakic or pseudophakic bullous keratopathy, leukoma; Table 2); half had previous multiple intraocular surgery and one eye had a tectonic lamellar graft four months before the index operation. IOL fixation or exchange is recorded as a non-cataract combination (combined false).

series.notes: Group mean (row 'BCVA'; SD in the 'Std deviation' row). Table 3 has no unit label; the Results text states that the mean BCVA is logMAR best-corrected visual acuity and cites Table 3. Columns Pre-op, 1 week, 1 month, 6 months and 1 year; per-visit numbers of eyes are not reported.

exclusions.reason: final follow-up without a stated time (mean follow-up 2 years, range 2-115 months); excluded by the protocol

exclusions.what: Table 3 rows 'Median', 'Minimum', 'Maximum' and 'P (pre-op vs. other variables)'
exclusions.reason: medians, ranges and p-values are not admissible

exclusions.what: BCVA means quoted in the abstract and Results text (preoperative, 1 month, 9 years, final follow-up, and final follow-up excluding eyes with preexisting retinal pathology)
exclusions.reason: text values: the preoperative and 1-month means differ from Table 3 (the table cells are cited); the 9-year and final values have no tabulated series with a stated time; the retinal-pathology subset is reported only at the final follow-up without its preoperative value

exclusions.what: Proportions of eyes with improved, maintained or worsened vision at the last follow-up

notes: Counting-finger and hand-motion vision: the article does not state how such vision was converted to logMAR for Table 3 (a case description mentions counting fingers close to face); values are kept as printed.

Ordinary attrition: graft failures, repeat penetrating keratoplasty and other events during follow-up are listed in Table 4; no eye is stated to be excluded from Table 3 and per-visit numbers of eyes are not reported.
Tables 1, 2 and 4 (demographics, indications, complications) are used for the group description only; astigmatism (Table 4 and text) is mentioned here only.
